title: Christmas Reindeer Chow
creator: Mary MQ
instructions: Combine the cereals, Bugles, pretzels and M&M's in a large bowl.
Pour melted white chocolate over the mix and gently stir until coated.
Spread onto a nonstick baking sheet and finish with holiday sprinkles.
Allow the chocolate to set, then break into bite-sized pieces.
notes: Recipe taken from the Reel caption (creator replied the caption holds the full recipe). No servings or prep/cook times were given. Quantities are exactly as listed in the caption; the creator confirmed 1 cup of each dry ingredient in a comment.
